security_recall_007.answer: yes; Recall period: 3 years. Order: Priority consideration. Notice: Information sessions & preference form. Response deadline: Not specified. Benefit restoration: Health benefits continued at own cost for 6 months.
security_recall_007.evidence: Any unit member whose service has been terminated because of the elimination of a position or a reduction in professional staff shall for a period of three years receive priority consideration for reemployment if he/she so desires and if appropriate vacancies develop. ... Information sessions to discuss two-year priority consideration for reemployment and other fringe benefits due terminated unit members will be arranged ... A Preference for Reassignment form will be completed ... may choose to continue membership in the health benefit plans offered by the Board of Education by paying the full cost of membership in these plans during those six months.

security_rif_criterion_008.answer: Certificate/classification type (Class II, provisional, regular), then tenure status, followed by length of service and job performance
security_rif_criterion_008.evidence: 1. Unit members holding Class II certificates 2. Non-tenured unit members holding provisional certificates 3. Non-tenured unit members holding regular certificates 4. Tenured unit members ... a unit member’s length of MCPS service and quality of job performance will receive equal consideration in determining those individuals who will be terminated.

security_probation_length_009.evidence: A unit member who has completed two consecutive years of successful experience with the Montgomery County Public Schools on a Regular Contract and has been recommended for tenure at the time leave is granted shall go on tenure at the time he/she returns from leave and is reassigned.

security_tenure_rules_010.evidence: A unit member who is on tenure at the time he/she is granted leave because of personal illness or illness in his/her immediate family shall remain on tenure. ...
